## Natural history notes

Chuck-will's-widow (Anthostomus carolinensis) is a migratory bird found throughout the southeastern United States, Mexico, Caribbean, and central and northern South America. It breeds in the U.S. and migrates south for the winter, with a year-round population found in South Florida. This nocturnal bird was named after its call and can be very vocal at night. It is typically seen at dawn and dusk, when it is out foraging for insects.
